tagline: Delivering world-class research with global impact through mathematical innovation
hero_kpi_rationale: The MIRA model is the central pillar of IMI's growth and impact, with recent expansion from 10 to 13 members, demonstrating scalable capacity for high-level technical research. This model is now extended at the national level via MInDS, making it a unique structural lever.

kpis.name: MIRA Headcount
kpis.explanation: Number of researchers associated with the MIRA model, at the core of IMI's operating model.
kpis.description: The MIRA team expanded from 10 to 13 members in 2024/25, with the arrival of three new researchers, strengthening multidisciplinary research capacity.
kpis.signal: 30% growth of flagship MIRA model in one year

kpis.name: Grant Income
kpis.explanation: Total amount of grants obtained to fund research projects.
kpis.description: Key grants including MInDS (£2M), Robot Dexterity (£2.2M) and WOW (£0.3M), totaling £4.5 million.
kpis.signal: Solid grant portfolio with high-impact projects

kpis.name: Consultancy Projects
kpis.explanation: Number of consultancy projects conducted with industrial or government partners.
kpis.description: IMI conducted 8 consultancy projects, generating practical recognition of its applied mathematical expertise.

kpis.name: Consultancy Income
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by external consultancy projects.
kpis.description: The 8 consultancy projects generated £424,000, demonstrating capacity to convert research into economic value.

kpis.name: Salary Return
kpis.explanation: Percentage of MIRA staff salaries funded by external grants.
kpis.description: The MIRA model maintains salary return above 85%, ensuring economic viability.
kpis.signal: Financially sustainable model with over 85% of costs covered

kpis.name: Research Themes
kpis.explanation: Number of strategic areas structuring IMI's research.
kpis.description: Themes include Environment, Health, Fluid Dynamics and Radiation Protection, directing research toward real-world impact.
kpis.signal: Clear positioning around 6 major societal challenges

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the past 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €2.48 billion in latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the past 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €0.64 billion in latest year

kpis.name: MInDS Grant
kpis.explanation: Amount of national grant to extend the MIRA model across the United Kingdom.
kpis.description: Securing the MInDS project at £2 million marks strategic expansion of the MIRA model at national scale.

kpis.name: Robot Dexterity Grant
kpis.explanation: Funding obtained for an innovative advanced robotics project.
kpis.description: Project funded by ARIA, agency dedicated to advanced inventions, highlighting orientation toward breakthrough R&D.

ai_positioning.summary: IMI integrates artificial intelligence cross-functionally within its research themes, particularly through data processing and numerical modeling, without making it an explicit central focus. Its MIRA model supports digital projects with strong potential for automation and machine learning.
evidence: Participation in MInDS (Mathematical Innovators in the Digital Space), national network focused on digital technical competencies
Robot Dexterity project funded by ARIA, potentially involving AI for robotic dexterity
Applied mathematical modeling of complex systems, compatible with generative AI approaches
